message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: Chen used his position as a business representative to embezzle/appropriate company funds 5万元 for personal debt. That's "挪用公款" (misappropriation of public funds) but here it's a private company, not public funds. In Chinese criminal law, "挪用公款罪" applies to state funds, not private. For private, it's "职务侵占" (embezzlement by a person in a position of trust) or "挪用资金" maybe "挪用资金罪" (misappropriation of funds) but that is for state-owned enterprises? Actually "职务侵占罪" applies to employees of enterprises, public or private, who use their position to illegally appropriate property of the unit. So the appropriate charge is "职务侵占". In examples, similar case: "职务侵占" used for a person who misappropriated funds from a law firm (张某). Also "挪用公款" used for state employees. So answer: [罪名]职务侵占<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: He returned the money, but still crime. No other. So single.
